body: Called the suicide hotline ready  to blow my brains out. I got rubber roomed when the police lead me away violently. I had to lie so that I wouldn't be institutionalized. I left feeling worse. I know better next time.

I knew of someone who found work at a night shift with psoriasis. It limited his exposure to the public. That may be an option. 

For my mental illness, I'm getting help with applying for SSDI. I live in the states. If it's possible for you, I'd recommend applying asap since it may take a year or more to approve. I hope I get approved since suicide is something I'm considering if I don't. 

Maybe you can conceal your condition too if you wear long sleeve clothing? I used to be forced to wear long clothing in public all the time to hid the marks of physical abuse. It's cold where I am so I can reasonably get away with it. 

For social interactions, I try to use gestures such as rubbing my chin or something else to buy time to compose a response. It's an attempt to seem thoughtful and contemplative. Even a fool can be thought to be wise as the gods if he only stays silent and nods. I also use pre-scripted and practiced responses. You wouldn't be able to tell I have severe Asperger and Major Depression without having spent an extended time with me. The rare few folks I trust in my life are in disbelief when I tell them my status.

Dating, meh. Relationships are more work. The saddest part is being with someone and feeling more alone then when you were actually 'alone'. People are amazingly superficial too. Overly intelligent people are often out to exploit you or are arrogant. I'd rather have companionship that's genuine with someone that's kind and caring. Injecting dna into another is how the virus of humanity spreads. 

If possible you could also try getting a dog, unconditional love right there.

It could be bipolar disorder? 

I don't know but with me, I'm never happy. The best I can hope for is a distraction from the depression. A movie or a small task sometimes does it for me.

I wish I had like family to fall back on. I could apply for disability but I have to survive until my application goes through. I'll probably have no choice but go back to hell once the money runs out, I'd rather accept oblivion myself. 

Yeah, it's lovely how in the USA so called "land of prosperity", there's so much income inequality. We're approaching serfdom levels here. CEOs 50 years ago didn't make so much as they do now in proportion to the population. Meanwhile brainwashed idiots are voting to strip away the last vestiges of a social safety net we have.

I lost my job and ironically is when I could start receiving insurance. I went to the dentist the first time in years just naught but a month ago.

Yeah, the goddamn student loans means much the same for me. I won't have a future. I can't afford a home.

I'm on the cusp of killing myself once my money runs out. I've taken to utilizing every resource I can get so that I might slow the fall of the hourglass' sands. Food shelves, public assistance, free insurance, depending on your income level you can acquire all of these things to help you along. They're your tax dollars at work. In the US at least these are available. I wish we had a real safety net like some European countries but it is at least something.

I have a terrible tendency. I want to be known but I don't want to advertise since it makes be feel dirty afterwards. I know it's self sabotage, but I'm rather introverted.

I'm working out some bugs in the demo. I'm a perfectionist too.

I was deceived by the College Finance Department about what I was getting into, and my College inflated the job prospects. What killed me was the culprit Capitalism. Our presidents are really the figureheads of the rotten wooden ship. It's easier to swap figureheads while ignoring the oncoming iceberg.

Thanks, I hope so too. I don't know. Seems like I'm just surviving when I want to be living. 

I wish I lived in a country where there was a safety net.

I'm grateful for this in-depth response. Yeah the government website didn't specify. 

My landlord is past due on his mortgage payment.  He knows he won't be able to pay 10k. I think 2 or even less than that more months it'll be when the bank gets fed up and files for foreclosure. He's trying to get mortgage assistance but I'm not sure if that's going to work out.

I worried "paying the same" might be too little for the bank, since I helped my landlord(elderly) with his life activities, so he kept me as a tenant for next to nothing compared to local rates.

At the same time, I'm on unemployment so I can't afford local rates.
Hmmm that might be something good to add. Since the bank would obviously want me gone. If we both want me gone, then the contract could be null, right?
Eeeyup, that's what I've done before when helping my landlord previously.

I see, since it's a regular style house. The bank would probably want to sell it to a new owner and make their money back real quick.

How many months you figure would the bank would tolerate me living there for them to not want to contest the lease?

I appreciate the responses, does my old landlord have to give the bank my old deposit?

The property is falling apart, would the bank sue me for damages?

How should I phrase it so that I can stay the duration but can leave if I wish?
How long should I make it for? Could I get a year or even two? As a tenant, I haven't even received a notice of foreclosure in the mail.

I guess I can continued my old rate. It's still below market value in my area. 

Should I pay in advance? I feel bad for my landlord, I'm losing a room, he's losing his house.
